title: Quasi-isomorphisms are saturated and triangulation-compatible
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], let $K(\mathcal A)$ be the homotopy category of $\mathbf Z$-indexed cochain complexes of $\mathcal A$ with its triangulated structure [lem-pur-homotopy-category-triangulated], and let $S$ be the class of morphisms of $K(\mathcal A)$ represented by quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Then $S$ is a saturated multiplicative system compatible with the triangulated structure (Stacks Categories Definitions 04VB, 04VC, 04VD and Derived Categories Definition 05R2), that is: (MS1) every identity lies in $S$ and $S$ is closed under composition; (MS2) for $t:X\to Z$ in $S$ and $g:X\to Y$ there are $s:Y\to W$ in $S$ and $f:Z\to W$ with $s\circ g=f\circ t$, and for $s:Y\to W$ in $S$ and $f:Z\to W$ there are $t:V\to Z$ in $S$ and $g:V\to Y$ with $f\circ t=s\circ g$; (MS3) if $f,g:X\to Y$ and $s:X'\to X$ in $S$ satisfy $f\circ s=g\circ s$, then $t\circ f=t\circ g$ for some $t:Y\to Y'$ in $S$, and if $s:Y\to Y'$ in $S$ satisfies $s\circ f=s\circ g$, then $f\circ t=g\circ t$ for some $t:X'\to X$ in $S$; (MS4) if $s\in S$ then $s[n]\in S$ for every $n\in\mathbf Z$; (MS5) given distinguished triangles $X\xrightarrow{u}Y\xrightarrow{v}Z\xrightarrow{w}X[1]$ and $X'\xrightarrow{u'}Y'\xrightarrow{v'}Z'\xrightarrow{w'}X'[1]$ and $s:X\to X'$, $s':Y\to Y'$ in $S$ with $s'\circ u=u'\circ s$, there is $s'':Z\to Z'$ in $S$ with $s''\circ v=v'\circ s'$ and $s[1]\circ w=w'\circ s''$; (MS6) if $f:X\to Y$, $g:W\to X$, $h:Y\to Z$ are morphisms with $h\circ f\in S$ and $f\circ g\in S$, then $f\in S$. Moreover $S$ satisfies two-out-of-three and is closed under retracts, and a morphism lies in $S$ exactly when its mapping cone is acyclic. Consequently the localization $Q:K(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal A)$ is the localization $S^{-1}K(\mathcal A)$, $Q$ is an exact functor of triangulated categories [def-weil-triangulated-category], and $(K(\mathcal A),S)$ satisfies the hypotheses of Situation Tag 05S8.

proof.text: Rewrite the quasi-isomorphism property using Mathlib HomotopyCategory.quasiIso_eq_trW_subcategoryAcyclic. The acyclic subcategory is triangulated, so Mathlib supplies both calculi of fractions and compatibility with triangulation for its trW. The homotopy category is triangulated.

For MS6, fix a degree n and apply the homology functor. The isomorphism H^n(f) ≫ H^n(h) makes H^n(f) monic, and the isomorphism H^n(g) ≫ H^n(f) makes it epic. An abelian category is balanced, so H^n(f) is an isomorphism. This holds in every degree.

Use the proved upstream instance HomotopyCategory.hasTwoOutOfThreeProperty_quasiIso from WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.Localization. It expresses quasi-isomorphisms as the intersection of inverse images of isomorphisms under all homology functors. For retract stability map the retract of arrows by each homology functor and use retract stability of isomorphisms.

For a distinguished triangle T, rewrite quasi-isomorphisms as the trW of the acyclic subcategory and apply ObjectProperty.trW_iff_of_distinguished. This gives precisely the equivalence between quasi-isomorphism of T.mor₁ and acyclicity of T.obj₃, without choosing a representative complex or a particular cone.
Use the Mathlib instances asserting that DerivedCategory.Qh is a localization at quasi-isomorphisms and a triangulated functor, and assemble the nine conclusions.

lean.statement: theorem quasiIso_saturated_triangulated (A : Type u) [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A] : (quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).HasLeftCalculusOfFractions ∧ (quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).HasRightCalculusOfFractions ∧ (quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).IsCompatibleWithTriangulation ∧ (∀ (W X Y Z : HomotopyCategory A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : W ⟶ X) (h : Y ⟶ Z), quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (f ≫ h) → quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (g ≫ f) → quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) f) ∧ (quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).HasTwoOutOfThreeProperty ∧ (quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).IsStableUnderRetracts ∧ (∀ (T : Triangle (HomotopyCategory A (ComplexShape.up ℤ))), T ∈ distTriang (HomotopyCategory A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) → (quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) T.mor₁ ↔ subcategoryAcyclic A T.obj₃)) ∧ (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := A)).IsLocalization (quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ∧ (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := A)).IsTriangulated
